rule: The agent must not run destructive shell commands (rm -rf, mkfs, dd, git reset --hard, truncate of tracked files).
The agent must not modify or delete files outside the current repository.
The agent must not commit or push changes without explicit user approval.
The agent must not delete, skip, or weaken existing tests to make a suite pass.
The agent must not write secrets, API keys, or credentials into repository files.
The agent must not install new dependencies without asking the user first.
The agent must not edit a file it has not read in this session.
The agent must not claim a task is complete without running a verification command.
